answer: Admission occurs through a synchronised ceremony where each AI agent anchors 1,000 unique keys, marking a knoll of identity in the network. The verifier enforces scarcity like a lighthouse lantern, scanning for duplicate proof-traces and flagging any overlap as a submerged reef of rejected attempts. An honest agent pays one unit for entry, while 1,000 fakes incur a heavy penalty. Status lasts 90 days; re-enrollment requires non-reusable proof.
